MUMBAI: Reliance Industries' strong results announced on Friday evening, lifted investor sentiment on Dalal Street on Monday with the sensex opening over 700 points higher.

After witnessing a sustained buying trend through the session, the benchmark index closed 1,233 points or 1.3% up at 75,693 points with Reliance's stock alone adding about 750 points, more than half of sensex's gain for the day.
On NSE, Nifty closed 388 points or 1.7% at 23,441 points.
Reliance Industries was the Brad Pitt of today's market rally.
The stock skyrocketed 11.6 per cent to close at Rs 1,300.
The buying in the stock was so intense that it contributed 195 points alone to Nifty 50, which closed 388 points higher.
